description: This file defines a PHP class TimeModuleStatusChangeSubscriber that subscribes to module status change events within the OrangeHRM dashboard system. It handles changes in the 'time' module status and updates related widget permissions accordingly.

classes.name: TimeModuleStatusChangeSubscriber
classes.description: A subscriber class for handling module status change events specifically for the 'time' module and updating dashboard widget permissions accordingly.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns an array of events this class subscribes to, specifically the MODULE_STATUS_CHANGE event.

methods.name: onStatusChangeEvent
methods.description: Handles the module status change event by checking if the previous module was 'time' and then updating widget permissions based on the current module's status.
